items.name: sfx_water_drip
items.text: one single water drop falling onto the steel edge of a kitchen knife on a counter, close, quiet, no reverb, no second drop

items.name: sfx_bronze_shimmer
items.text: a soft short metallic shimmer of a polished bronze blade catching light, gentle airy ring, no music, no melody

items.name: sfx_glass_shimmer
items.text: a soft glassy shimmer swell like light sliding across a museum display case, airy, short, no music

items.name: sfx_hall_murmur
items.text: quiet empty museum hall at night, very faint distant footsteps and air conditioning, low, calm

items.name: sfx_sheen_chime
items.text: one single soft high metallic chime, short, clean, no repeats

items.name: sfx_wind_snow
items.text: cold winter wind over an open muddy field with light snow, gentle, steady

items.name: sfx_spade_soil
items.text: one single shovel stroke digging into wet heavy clay soil, close, one stroke only

items.name: sfx_earth_rumble
items.text: deep low earth rumble, short, subtle, like soil shifting far below

items.name: sfx_wood_lid_lift
items.text: a heavy old wooden coffin lid lifted slowly by two people, deep wood creak and a short scrape, one movement

items.name: sfx_water_rinse
items.text: washing a small wooden object in a shallow basin of water, a few gentle splashes and drips

items.name: sfx_sword_draw
items.text: a bronze sword slowly drawn out of a lacquered wooden sheath: soft scrape, then one clear long metallic ring

items.name: sfx_paper_flutter
items.text: a few old paper letters fluttering and being turned over, soft, dry

items.name: sfx_clapper
items.text: one single film clapperboard clap, close, dry, no second clap

items.name: sfx_paper_slice
items.text: a sharp blade slicing through a thick stack of paper in one quick stroke, crisp

items.name: sfx_tiny_crackle
items.text: a tiny dry crackle of old metal, very short and quiet

items.name: sfx_rewind_whirr
items.text: a short soft tape rewind whirr that rises in pitch, smooth

items.name: sfx_layer_thud
items.text: one single dull soft thud of a heavy wooden lid closing, muffled, short, no reverb tail

items.name: sfx_kitchen_hum
items.text: quiet kitchen at night, faint refrigerator hum, calm, steady

items.name: sfx_seal_stamp
items.text: one single red seal stamp pressed onto thick paper, one soft low thump, no second hit
